summary: Iteration 5 stock module tested across public backend APIs and desktop/mobile UI. Backend pytest: 12/17 passed. Stock CRUD, branch scoping, duplicate protection, staff read/write RBAC, upload validation/max count, normal photo serve/delete, booking snapshot/resnapshot, cross-branch invalid stock clearing, stock deletion unlink with retained snapshot, snapshot file serving, and regression endpoints passed. Five failures remain: cross-branch photo deletion vulnerability, booking Unlink persistence failure on PUT, and three requested auth-hardening failures. Frontend manager/staff/super flows, stock search/autofill, photo thumbnails, invoice photo rendering/omission, and responsive layout passed; stock photo upload trigger is disabled in the stock dialog.

critical.issue: Photo ownership is not validated. A BNG manager used an owned BNG stock_id with a KLN stock photo_id and received 200, soft-deleting the cross-branch file. The endpoint scopes only stock_id, then updates db.files by photo_id globally.

Requested auth hardening is absent: login sets no application HttpOnly auth cookie (only Cloudflare __cf_bm), and the sixth invalid attempt after five failures still returns 401 instead of lockout/rate-limit status.
CORS accepts an unconfigured malicious origin with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while credentials are enabled; backend CORS_ORIGINS is '*', not an explicit allowlist.

minor.issue: Sending {"stock_id": null} does not unlink stock or clear stock_photos; response retains the old stock_id/snapshot. This breaks persisted Unlink behavior when editing an existing booking.

ui_bugs.issue: After creating a stock item, Add photo is disabled even though stockId and a valid upload endpoint exist. Directly populating the hidden file input proved upload/backend/thumbnail flow works. Root cause is disabled={uploading || !bookingId}, which ignores stockId.

integration_issues.issue: The UI clears the link locally, but PUT sends stock_id=null and the backend drops null values, so an existing booking remains linked after save/reload.

action_items: In delete_stock_photo, require photo_id to be present in the scoped stock item's photos array and update db.files with both id and stock_id; return 404 when not matched.
Allow explicit stock_id=null in update_booking and set both stock_id=null and stock_photos=[] so edit-form Unlink persists.
Change PhotoUploader upload button disabling to uploading || !endpointBase (or uploading || (!bookingId && !stockId)).
Implement application HttpOnly authentication cookie and five-failure lockout/rate limiting per the auth playbook; update frontend credential handling accordingly.
Replace wildcard CORS with explicit configured frontend origins while retaining credentials support.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1,219 lines, well above the 700-line threshold; split auth, stock/files, bookings, RBAC, audit, and stats into focused routers/services.
update_booking builds update with `if v is not None`, which erases the semantic difference between an omitted field and an explicitly supplied null field.
delete_stock_photo pulls from one stock but independently soft-deletes any global file id, creating an IDOR/cross-tenant destructive action.
PhotoUploader derives endpointBase from stockId or bookingId correctly, but its disabled condition checks only bookingId.
Storage URL and app namespace are hardcoded in server.py instead of environment configuration; login also exposes default admin credentials in the rendered UI.
Static startup review confirms existing admin password hashes are refreshed when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes; live DB verification confirms the seeded admin hash starts with $2b$.

success_rate.frontend: 90% of tested stock/booking/invoice flows; one blocking stock-upload control defect

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed stock items, bookings, and staff users plus test stock photos. Parent stock/bookings/users were cleaned up; uploaded object/file artifacts can remain orphaned because deleting stock does not remove its file records/objects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_stock.py after fixes. Expected current failures are cross-stock photo delete, PUT booking stock_id=null, auth cookie, CORS allowlist, and brute-force lockout. Super/staff/manager desktop flows and mobile Stock layout passed. Frontend photo workflow only succeeded by setting the hidden photo-file-input directly because the visible trigger is disabled. First no-photo invoice attempt had a test timing issue around suggestions; corrected direct-booking retry passed and cleaned up.
rca_of_the_issue: Three direct implementation defects: PhotoUploader checks !bookingId instead of endpoint availability; update_booking filters out explicit nulls before unlink logic; delete_stock_photo does not bind photo_id to the scoped stock/file owner. Auth hardening is not implemented: JWT remains in localStorage, CORS is wildcard, and login has no failure counter/lockout.
